sourceTitle: It was a Lover and His Lass
description: "It was a Lover and His Lass" by Mrs. Oliphant is a novel written in the late 19th century. The story introduces readers to the mysterious and unfinished Murkley Castle in the Scottish countryside, where the narrative begins to weave together the lives of its residents and the effects of a wealthy man's poor decisions.
